title: Showcase: replace the three paid-invoice line guards with a closedStates declaration, as the runtime proof (ADR-0162 item 3)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed · Source: ADR-0162 Execution item 3 (accepted by merge 972114df)

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：把示例应用里「已付款发票不能动明细」的三段手写代码删掉，换成发票对象上的一行声明，并把前后对比跑一遍记下来。
- 用户会看到什么：示例应用里已付款的发票，表头也不能再改、整张不能删、明细行任何字段都不能改；这三处是新增的拒绝，是设计本意。
- 不做会怎样：新能力没有一个真实应用证明它能替代手写代码，其他应用也没有可以照抄的样例。
- 顺序：排在声明和执行那张卡之后，最好和它同一次发布，作为运行证明。

## What happens

The showcase guards a paid invoice's lines with three hand-written hooks in `examples/app-showcase/src/data/hooks/index.ts`, with their own refusal sentences (`PAID_INVOICE_LINE_ADD_REFUSAL`, `PAID_INVOICE_LINE_REMOVE_REFUSAL`, `PAID_INVOICE_LINE_MOVE_REFUSAL`). They guard add, remove and move. They do not guard the invoice's header, its delete, or most fields of a line.

Card #36253 asks for this conversion as the proof ("Convert the showcase's paid-invoice hooks to the declaration as the proof"), and ADR-0162 D10 names it as the runtime proof ADR-0054 asks of a new key.

## Expected

- The three hooks and their sentences are deleted. The invoice object declares `closedStates` on its status for the paid state.
- The card records, as a dogfood run against the running app, each refusal the hooks gave before and the declaration gives after.
- It records every outcome that changes by design. ADR-0162 Execution item 3 lists them:
  - a caller's edit of a paid invoice's header is refused, where today every field but the one that carries `readonlyWhen` lands;
  - a caller's delete of a paid invoice is refused, where today only the button is hidden;
  - a caller's update of a line under a paid invoice is refused whole, where today a change to `description`, `position`, `service_start` or `receipt` lands, and a write that carries `product`, `quantity` or `unit_price` has those keys stripped and the rest lands;
  - adding, moving and removing a line under a paid invoice stay refused, now with the platform's code and sentence where the app worded three of its own.
- A seed or import of finished invoices still loads: it runs as system, or creates the invoice open and closes it last.

## Done when

- [ ] No paid-invoice guard hook is left in the showcase, and the invoice declares the key.
- [ ] The dogfood record is in the PR: the before and after of each of the four outcomes above, taken from the running app.
- [ ] The showcase's own tests that asserted the three app sentences now assert `RECORD_LOCKED`.
- [ ] The showcase's seed loads, and its flows still run: none of them uses the approval status mirror on the invoice, and its batch sign-off under a `map` names no closing field and runs under a parent that carries no record, so the approvals conditions of item 7 refuse none of them. Each is checked, not assumed.
- [ ] The liveness row of the key points at this proof, if the key's own card did not carry one.

Category ③: maintainer-directed. A build card of ADR-0162, child of #36253.
Grade: area:data · Feature · n/a (not a defect) · reach: the showcase app and every author who copies it · evidence: read (the three hooks on `main` at `972114df`)
Suggested-grade: p2 · part of the feature #36253; it is the proof the key's release needs
Size: M (one app: its hooks, one object, its tests and the dogfood record).
Business reason: carried from #36253. The proof that the declaration replaces hand-written guards, and the sample other apps copy.
Reader: seat 2 (repo:objectstack#2), a card thread, effort high; the dogfood run follows the `dogfood-verification` skill.
Blocked-by: #37768 (item 1). If the liveness gate wants the runtime proof in the same release as the key, this card lands on the same trunk branch before it merges.
Clause-②: no. An example app changes; no published package contract moves.
Metadata-protocol: none
Dedupe: searched `closedStates` (all issues): 1 hit, #36253 itself.
Related: #36253, PR #37606 (ADR-0162), #24731 (the guards this card removes).
